desc_en: Perforated one-way vision film for shopfront windows, vehicle windows and glass partitions: a full printed graphic outside, an open view from inside. Perforation pattern, roll width and pricing are confirmed per quotation.
desc_zh: 单透膜（穿孔背胶膜），适用于店铺橱窗、车辆玻璃和玻璃隔断：外看完整印刷画面，内看通透。孔位比例、幅宽与价格按询价确认。

applications: Transit and bus shelter window graphics
detail_en.artwork: Please provide print-ready artwork, finished glass dimensions, quantity and destination. Note that fine detail and small text read less clearly through perforations; bold layouts work best.
detail_en.brief: Please specify the finished size, quantity, perforation requirement, whether lamination is needed, packing requirements and destination country or region.
detail_en.caveat: The 60/40 and 70/30 perforation ratios are the standard options. Film thickness, roll width, minimum order quantity and pricing are not listed on this page: they are confirmed against the actual specification of each order, so please state your required specification when enquiring. Vehicle window use must comply with local visibility regulations.
delivery: Production and dispatch timing confirmed per order
Sea freight to Australian main ports is around 40 days as a reference
Photos of the finished graphics and the export packing are sent for your confirmation before dispatch
Standard packing: rolls packed for transport; alternative packing can be confirmed per order
finishing: Large-format printing on the white face
highlights: Full printed graphic seen from outside
View out and daylight kept from inside
White print face with black adhesive side
Perforation ratio, roll width and pricing confirmed per quotation
detail_en.lead: One-way vision perforated film turns glass into advertising space without closing it off: passers-by see the printed graphic, while people inside keep their view and daylight. Two standard perforation ratios are available: 70/30 keeps more printable surface, so the graphic reads fuller; 60/40 opens more of the film, giving a clearer view out and more daylight inside. Choose the ratio for the glazing and the viewing distance; roll width and pricing are confirmed per order.

applications: 店铺橱窗与零售玻璃画面
玻璃隔断与办公玻璃装饰
公交站台等公共交通玻璃画面
detail_zh.artwork: 请提供印刷文件、玻璃成品尺寸、数量及目的地。孔位会弱化细小文字与精细细节，版面以粗放醒目为宜。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供成品尺寸、数量、孔位比例要求、是否需要覆膜、包装要求及收货国家/地区。
detail_zh.caveat: 打孔率 60/40 与 70/30 为常规规格；膜厚、幅宽、起订量及价格本页未列明，按每笔订单的实际规格确认，询价时请注明所需规格。需要发票可代开，确认订单时说明即可。用于车辆玻璃时须符合当地透光与可视法规。
delivery: 西安同城（以确认下单时间为准）：11:00 前下单当天下午送达，19:00 前次日中午前送达，19:00 后次日下午送达
三环内必达，三环外多数郊区可达；自有封闭式面包车专送，卷材整卷送货上门
江浙沪皖由浙江嘉兴海盐合作工厂发货；其他地区时效按订单确认
标准包装：卷材运输包装；具体包装形式可按订单确认
finishing: 白色面大幅面喷绘印刷
highlights: 从外看是完整印刷画面
从内保持通透视野与采光
白色印刷面、黑色背胶面
打孔率 60/40 与 70/30 两种常规规格可选
打孔率、幅宽及价格按询价确认
detail_zh.lead: 单透膜把玻璃变成广告位，又不把光线和视野封死：路人看到的是完整画面，店内的人仍能看向室外。常规打孔率有 60/40 与 70/30 两种：70/30 印刷面占比更高、画面更完整；60/40 孔占比更高、从内向外更通透、采光更好。按玻璃场景与观看距离选比例，幅宽与价格按订单确认。

seo_description_en: Wholesale one-way vision perforated window film for retail windows, vehicle graphics and glass partitions. Perforation pattern, roll widths and pricing are confirmed per quotation. Enquire about bulk orders and international shipping.
